text: MBA program of Sichuan University started in 1998; the program aims to develop outstanding and innovative professional managers with distinctive "4M Cultivate Model", excellent faculty, specific curriculum and a full range of career service. Through years of development, the program has become the leading MBA program in west China.The cultivate mode of MBA program is featured with four specific aspects, which are management skills, management practices, general theories and professional qualities. Duration Two-year program. Student may choose to expand study duration to 5 years Dual-tutor Project Each student can choose one academic tutor and one entrepreneur tutor. Executive management officers of excellent enterprises are invited to be entrepreneur tutors. Career Service Students are provided with a whole range of career services including career assessment, face to face consulting, career development workshop, simulated interview, resume writing guidance, job postings, and internship opportunities. It facilitate students to better position themselves and deeply understand employment market, make career plan, improve job seeking skills, strengthen competitiveness advantages, and realize short-term and long-term career goals. Alumni Network Alumni Association holds various activities such as industrial communication seminars, forums, and alumni parties and so on. Alumni share resources and build up life time friendships. Program Recognition 2003 The World Championship of Global Management Challenge---GMCC 2005 Awarded as one of “The Most Valuable Full-Time MBA programs of China”---“Forbes” 2006 Awarded as one of “The Fastest Earning Increasing MBA programs in China”--- “Forbes” 2007 Awarded as one of “The Fastest Earning Increasing MBA programs in China”---“Forbes” 2010 Awarded as one of “ The Best Ten Business Schools”---Tencent.com 2011 Hospital MBA was awarded as “The Most Competitive MBA”---21st Century Media 2012“The most valuable MBA program in China” --- “Forbes” Degree and Certificates The Post-graduate diploma of Sichuan University and the Certificate of Master Degree
